name: clean-booking-success (synthetic)
agentPrompt: You are a scheduling assistant. Your job on every call: greet the caller, ask for their full name, ask for a phone number, confirm a specific appointment date and time, and close the call politely.

transcript.text: Hi, thanks for calling! How can I help you today?
I'd like to book an appointment for next Tuesday.
Sure! Can I get your name please?
Thanks Maria. And what's the best phone number to reach you?
Great, I've got you down for Tuesday at 2 PM. Does that work?
Wonderful, see you then! Have a great day.

scorecard.name: Captures caller name
scorecard.description: Pass if the agent asks for and receives the caller's name.

scorecard.name: Captures phone number
scorecard.description: Pass if the agent asks for and receives a phone number.

scorecard.name: Confirms appointment time
scorecard.description: Pass if the agent confirms a specific date and time for the appointment.

scorecard.name: Polite closing
scorecard.description: Pass if the call ends with a polite closing statement.
